resources.string: Every switch here writes a real setting into this instance. Game options apply the next time you launch.
Could not write the game options
The camera eases into turns instead of snapping, so fast mouse movement glides. Costs nothing.
Removes the game's own frame limit so it runs as fast as the device allows.
Stops the frame rate being locked to the screen refresh. The single easiest win.
The biggest lever of all. Each step down is a large cut in the geometry drawn.
How far entities and ticks run. Lower costs almost nothing visually and frees a lot of CPU.
Turns off fancy leaves, water and clouds rendering.
Drops the per-face light blending across the whole world.
Removes the shadow blob under every mob and player.
Removes the cloud layer, which is a full-screen quad redrawn every frame.
Keeps only the particles that matter; the rest are pure fill rate.
Stops menus blurring the world behind them every frame - this is what makes the cursor lag.
Stops per-face colour blending between neighbouring biomes.
Stops the home screen's background clip and idle animations, so scrolling and the drawer stay fluid.
Camera smoothing, frame rate, render distance and twelve more levers, all in one place.
